name: Reading the Ley Lines
summary: On Zephras Isle, young Skyborne seek the arcane currents beneath their feet. Falorne Fallwind sends them to Thendal Grove to feel power rising through the elemental plane.

sections.title: Arcane Currents of the Elemental Plane
sections.body: Ley lines run beneath Zephras Isle, even through the elemental plane. Strange elementals and the hostile Al'Aketh cross the island as these buried currents rise toward the surface. For those with the bloodline and knowledge to channel them, the exposed lines open a path to raw arcane power.

sections.title: Highborne Legacy
sections.body: Falorne Fallwind urges initiates to claim their Highborne ancestry instead of seeking favor from wind spirits. The local Windshapers and the Al'Aketh both look to such spirits. Fallwind believes survival amid the elemental plane's harsh powers depends on mastering the arcane force beneath the ground, rather than asking foreign creatures for mercy.

sections.title: Thendal Standing Stones
sections.body: Northeast of the settlement, Thendal Grove's ancient standing stones mark a powerful meeting of ley lines. Roiling winds and Al'Aketh converts surround this exposed place. There, initiates can attune their senses to the ley line's pulse and unleash the full potential of their natural racial abilities.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Reading the Ley Lines?
aliases: who starts reading the ley lines
faq.answer: Falorne Fallwind on Zephras Isle gives young Skyborne this rite as they learn to channel their ancestral arcane power.

faq.q: Where is the ley line located?
faq.answer: The ley line lies northeast of the settlement, at the Thendal Standing Stones in Thendal Grove, amid hostile elementals and Al'Aketh converts.

faq.q: Why are ley lines present in the elemental plane?
faq.answer: Arcane conduits run beneath the ground even in the elemental plane. The ley lines have begun to break through the surface, giving Skyborne direct access to powerful currents.

faq.q: How does Falorne Fallwind view the Windshapers?
faq.answer: Falorne disdains the Windshapers' reverence for air spirits. He sees it as weak supplication to uncaring elemental beings, no better than the Al'Aketh's worship.

faq.q: What ability is required to channel the ley line?
faq.answer: You use the Skyborne racial ability Read Ley Line while standing at the energy convergence by the standing stones.

faq.q: What benefit does tapping into ley lines provide?
faq.answer: Tapping an exposed ley line channels raw arcane energy into the user, heightening magical prowess. Its effects vary with the nature of the conduit.

angles.text: As a Skyborne, you awaken your innate Highborne ancestry and learn to channel subterranean ley energy into your spellcasting.
As a Mage, you can draw on exposed ley lines as a reservoir of raw power amid elemental storms.
